npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30473-03.htm.text: Priest Bandellos: The Mark of the Healer is reserved for those who understand the healing and purifying power of light. These properties of light transcend all tribal distinctions. If you wish to take the challenge, I have but one favor I must ask...

links.text: "I will challenge the Test of the Healer"

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30473-01.html.text: Priest Bandellos: The Mark of the Healer is reserved for those who understand the healing and purifying power of light. These properties of light transcend all tribal distinctions. One day you will be tested to determine if you are worthy to receive this mark. You are not ready for this test yet. D…

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30473-02.html.text: Priest Bandellos: It is not the will of Einhasad that you take the Test of the Healer right now. A more suitable test awaits you elsewhere... May the grace of moonlight shine upon your path... (Quest available only for Cleric, Elven Oracle, Human Knight, Paladin, or Elven Knights above level 39.)

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30473-05.html.text: Priest Bandellos: Have you any news of the child? I wish I could tell you to take your time, but this is of the utmost urgency. If you don't have the time, you may give up, someone else will take up the cause...

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30473-07.html.text: Priest Bandellos: I don't like the way this is looking. I must send a guard to protect the child immediately. And I must report this to the High Priest at once! Master Sorius has told me of your great contribution to this effort. He was very complimentary of your skills. There may come a day when I…

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30473-06.html.text: Priest Bandellos: I don't like the way this is looking. I must send a guard to protect the child immediately. And I must report this to the High Priest at once! Master Sorius has told me of your great contribution to this effort. He was very complimentary of your skills. You have certainly earned t…

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30473-04.htm.text: Priest Bandellos: There is a very old prophecy that says a day will come when all the people of this world will suffer under an overwhelming dark energy. In those days a girl will be born, a perfect representative of Einhasad, sent to purify this wicked world. And now a child is born, a girl who cl…

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30473-04a.htm.text: Priest Bandellos: An ancient prophecy says that one day, when darkness fills the world as water does a bowl, and the groaning of the people can be heard in the rocks of the land itself, there will be born a girl-child, sent by Einhasad, who will cleanse the world. Now comes word that the long-await…

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30473-08.html.text: Priest Bandellos: Oh my, this is it! This is the holy statue that was stolen from us by bandits when we were on our way to the Gludio shrine! I hate to ask, but could you possibly return this relic to our shrine? We have been lost without it.

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30473-09.html.text: Priest Bandellos: Thank you. Now take this Mark of the Healer . May the blessings of Einhasad be upon you... We will never forget the help that you have given to us and to our shrine.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30473-note.text: Priest Bandellos: May the blessing of starlight rest upon you. I teach healing and preservation magic to Mystics of the Elven race. I would like to teach you the holy songs of Einhasad and Eva, but the religious commandments forbid me to. I am sorry.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30473.html.text: Priest Bandellos: Welcome, child of the forest. This temple is where the Humans serve Einhasad. We Elves, who worship under the trees of the forest and the starry skies, have difficulty understanding how they can commune with the gods from within a building of stone and brick, but each race has its…

links.text: Cleanse the pomander to reset your skills.
Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/learn-lowl.text: In order to use the Skill Transfer system, you must be level 76 or higher and have completed your 3rd class transfer.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/cleanse-no.text: Do you really want to reset your transfer skills? You must use all your Holy Pomanders in order to use this service. After all, 10 million adena is a huge sum of money. Use the rest of your pomanders, then try your request again. Do not fret. I will make sure that all of the Holy Pomanders you used…
To reset the skill link requires 10 million Adena. In addition, your class must corresponding to the skill.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
